title: Peggy Lee and how much of her came from Billie
summary: Humes met Peggy Lee in California, who sang her baby to sleep with 'Ebobaleeba'. Dance says Peggy took much from Billie Holiday and made millions while Billie struggled; Humes shrugs that is the business.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
